                         Link Your Google AdSense Account
                    

                    
Connect your Publisher ID to monetize all page views with live Google Ads.

                

                
            


            
            

                
                

                    
                    
                

                
                    Format: ca-pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX or pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX.
                
            


            
            

                

                    

                        Step 1: Locate your Publisher ID in AdSense
                    

                    

                        Log in to your Google AdSense Dashboard. Click Account → Settings → Account information. Copy your 16-digit Publisher ID.
                    

                


                

                    

                        Step 2: Paste ID Above & Click "Save & Sync"
                    

                    

                        Saving updates src/_data/site.json, updates your public /ads.txt authorization file, and regenerates your static site templates automatically.
                    

                


                

                    

                        Step 3: Add Your Site Domain in AdSense
                    

                    

                        In your AdSense dashboard, navigate to Sites → Add Site. Enter your custom domain (e.g. viralson.com). AdSense will verify the meta tags already present in your pages and the /ads.txt file.
